goal: Make a restaurant menu as a Word document for a small Italian place: sections for starters, pasta, pizza, mains and desserts, 4 items each with a one-line description and a price, and a note about gluten-free options at the bottom. Save it as {dir}\italian-menu.docx

Make an Excel weekly payroll sheet for 6 workers: columns for name, hourly rate, regular hours, overtime hours, regular pay (formula), overtime pay at 1.5 times the rate (formula) and total pay (formula), plus a totals row with SUM formulas. Fill in sample names and hours. Save it as {dir}\weekly-payroll.xlsx

Build a one-page portfolio website for a wedding photographer: a hero with her name, a gallery grid of 9 placeholder boxes with captions, a packages section with 3 prices, and a contact section with a mailto link. One self-contained HTML file with CSS inside, mobile friendly. Save it as {dir}\portfolio.html

persona: Ben, collects contacts at trade shows
goal: Write a Python script that converts contacts.csv (columns: name, company, phone, email) into a single contacts.vcf file with one vCard per contact, and prints how many vCards it wrote. Also create a sample contacts.csv with 8 rows. The script reads contacts.csv from its own folder and uses only the standard library. Save both in {dir} as csv_to_vcard.py and contacts.csv

Create a product catalog as a JSON file for a handmade jewelry shop: a list of 15 products, each with id, name, category (rings, necklaces, earrings), price, materials (a list), in_stock (true or false) and a short description. Save it as {dir}\catalog.json

Make an Excel sheet that compares auto insurance quotes from three carriers (Carrier A, B and C) for one client: rows for liability, collision, comprehensive, uninsured motorist, roadside, and a monthly premium total per carrier using SUM formulas, plus a row that shows the cheapest carrier using a formula. Save it as {dir}\auto-quote-compare.xlsx

persona: Leo, runs IT for a small office
goal: Write a Node.js command line password generator passgen.js using node:crypto: options --length (default 16) and --count (default 1), always includes upper, lower, digit and symbol, prints one password per line. When run with no options it prints one 16 character password. Save it as {dir}\passgen.js

Write a standard operating procedure for opening a coffee cart each morning: a checklist from arrival to first sale (equipment, cleaning, stock, cash drawer, safety), with times, written so a new hire can follow it. Save it as {dir}\opening-sop.md

Write a SQLite SQL script for a small school library: tables for books, students and loans with foreign keys, 15 sample books, 8 students and 10 loans (some returned, some overdue), and a final query listing overdue loans with the student and book title. Save it as {dir}\library.sql

persona: Dev, keeps a small Linux server
goal: Write a bash script that compresses log files older than 7 days in /var/log/myapp with gzip, deletes .gz files older than 30 days, and prints a summary. Use set -euo pipefail and a LOG_DIR variable at the top. Save it as {dir}\rotate-logs.sh
